annotations.title: Check what China requires to import a UK product

description: Use when the user asks what it takes to export a UK product to China (whisky, gin, biscuits, tea, chocolate, skincare, infant formula, pet food, cashmere, machinery and about 200 more). Says what China requires: China Customs (GACC) manufacturer registration route, the import tariff and VAT, whether the cross-border e-commerce (CBEC) route is open, Chinese labelling, certification and the main national standards, plus 2025 UK export value. Facts come only from official sources, each with its link and the date it was checked. Accepts a product name in English or Chinese, or an HS code.

locale.description: Language for names and links: en (default) or zh (Simplified Chinese).

product.description: The product in English or Chinese (e.g. "Scotch whisky", "护肤霜"), or a 6-digit HS code.

name: check_china_import_rules
